name: Nuoc mam Sa Chau
summary: A Nam Định fish sauce chosen for a Top 100 list of gift specialties, also printed as nước nắm. It is a different sauce from the nước mắm chắt of Giao Hải.
origin: Nam Định, as a named gift on Báo Nam Định, 30 January 2023 and 25 November 2022. The 30 January article also prints nước nắm on a stall list.
seoTitle: Nuoc mam Sa Chau — a Nam Dinh gift sauce
seoDescription: A Nam Định gift fish sauce on a Top 100 list, separate from the Giao Hải nước mắm chắt.
